title: AP Labs hub
description: One hub: a slash command whose menu lists the modules that name it. Lives at <app>/hubs/<id>.json. Unknown keys are errors. sees is required; notes is optional.

id.description: Must equal the file name without .json.

command.description: The slash command, lower case, at most 32 characters.

description.description: The slash command's description in Slack.

usage_hint.description: Optional hint shown after the command in Slack.

welcome.description: Optional one-paragraph welcome shown above the menu the first time a person opens the hub. Default: a generic welcome naming the hub.

sees.description: Required (plan brightside-v0, D1): what this hub may see. context: the profile's context files in the AI's prompt; data: the query runner; rules: the truth blocks, guardrails and forbidden columns. [] sees none of them. Fail closed: nothing is seen by default.

notes.description: Optional (plan brightside-v1, D6, Story 19.1): the id of another hub whose notes (its added context) this hub shares: one store, read and written from both hubs. Leave it out for the hub's own notes. Boot refuses a hub that does not exist, the hub itself, a hub that shares another hub's notes (no chains), and ask, add-context or data-sources modules on the sharing hubs with different resource keys. sees still decides what each hub gets from the profile.

feedback.description: Optional line in the hub's Help saying how to give feedback. Default: tell the profile's admins.
